title: East Maui Water Authority grant program funding
summary: As of September 18, the East Maui Water Authority's grant program has $150,000 in funding this year, up from the $100,000 grant announced in July. Staff had said in July that the next round would give out $150,000. The money traces back to a foundation's $100,000 commitment for early planning work, with access to grant funds starting in July 2026.

timeline.text: The East Maui Water Authority grant program's funding doubled this year to $150,000.
Staff said the authority's next round of grants will give out $150,000.
Staff are preparing a proposal with basic financial information for the foundation this month.
Staff said a foundation committed $100,000 to the water authority for early planning work.
